build: Modwerk's linker (scripts/link-image.mjs): the Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant ba530f45, the site builder's pick for this module) + this folder's Ctrl In Perf 1.0.0-experimental, materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version CP02

emulator.name: analog-emu
emulator.settings: a fresh card (no card image); key presses held 12M (NO 80M); DTBOOT_STEPS=1 (a frame 40M after each key release)

conditions: Headless cold boot of CP02. NO at 4503M, 5303M, 6103M and 6903M (held 80M) clear the missing-calibration notices; GLOBAL at 7503M; DOWN x6 from 8003M, one every 300M (CONTROL); YES at 10003M (CONTROL); YES at 10503M (CONTROL INPUT 1, MODE OFF); RIGHT at 11003M (MODE CV); DOWN x3 from 11403M, one every 300M (PERF DEST). The same plan on an image linked with irpina's core-ar2 0.7 release (CP01) gives byte-identical frames.

captures.plan: the conditions' plan, ending on the third DOWN: PERF DEST, the last row, at OFF
as perf-dest-off.png, then RIGHT at 12303M: PERF DEST PF1
